build: Modwerk's linker (scripts/link-image.mjs in modwerk-source-tools): the Modwerk base for core-ar2 0.7 (plain variant ba530f45, vendored) + this folder's velocity-humanise 1.2.0, materialised against stock OS 1.74 (cb0f99d6…e123), --version VH12

emulator.name: analog-emu (trigcondition's Rytm and A4 emulator built on rytm-emu; its history holds rytm-emu c5732f0, 951dcbc and e914f46)
emulator.settings: no card image, JIT on, --every 1000M; DTBOOT_STEPS=1 DTBOOT_PNG_DIR=out DTBOOT_TURN_PNG=out

conditions: Headless cold boot; four held NO presses clear the missing-calibration notices; a short TRIG press (12M) opens BD's TRIG page; FUNC is held while encoder 1 (VEL) turns up in twenty-four steps, with a zero-count turn first to frame the held state. Stock 1.74 with the same input gives byte-identical frames until FUNC is held; from then on it shows VEL and the trig velocity where VH12 shows RND and N. The three frames are byte-identical to 1.1's captures on VH74. Playback was not judged in the emulator.
